Subject: Update on Department Budget Request

Dear [Recipient Name],

Thank you for reviewing our recent budget increase request. We understand that the current proposal did not align with the company’s financial strategy, and we appreciate the feedback regarding the need for greater detail.

We are committed to ensuring our department’s resources are used effectively and in support of the company’s broader goals. To that end, we are preparing a revised proposal that includes a more comprehensive justification, along with concrete examples and data outlining the anticipated benefits of the requested funds. We will resubmit this updated request shortly for your consideration.

Please let us know if there are specific metrics or formats you would prefer us to use in the revised submission.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
